name: Sakazaki Hinako
source:
Since she was young she always aspired to work in the fashion world.
After she graduated from university her wish was granted and she got a job with the apparel maker ''Licht Craft'.
However since they were shorthanded instead of women's clothing she was assigned to work in a shop that sells clothing from their men's brand 'La Crima'.

A bright and hardworking woman.
Her parents died when she was young so she was raised by her grandparents.
